verses.1: In the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting in front of me. Then the hand of the LORD fell on me.
verses.2: I looked, and behold, a form like that of a man, from the waist downward like fire, and from the waist upward like the gleam of an electric flash.
verses.3: He extended a form of a hand, took hold of my hair, and lifted me up in a wind between the earth and the sky, and brought me to Jerusalem in a vision of God to the entrance of the inner gate facing north, where the idol of jealousy was located.
verses.4: And there the glory of the God of Israel appeared, just as I had seen in the plain.
verses.5: He said to me, "Son of man, look now toward the north." I looked toward the north, and behold, at the north of the gate of the altar was the idol of jealousy.
verses.6: He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man, what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel is committing far from My sanctuary? And you will yet see greater abominations."
verses.7: He brought me to the entrance of the courtyard, and there I saw a hole in the wall.
verses.8: He said to me, "Break through the wall, son of man." I broke through the wall and saw a door.
verses.9: He said to me, "Go in and see the evil abominations that they are doing here."
verses.10: I went in and saw, and behold, every kind of creeping thing and beast that is abhorrent, and all the images of the house of Israel were carved around the wall.
verses.11: There were seventy men, elders of the house of Israel, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing among them, each with a censer in his hand, and a cloud of incense was rising.
verses.12: He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each in the private chamber of their houses, saying, 'The LORD does not see us, the LORD has abandoned the land'?"
verses.13: He said to me, "You will yet see greater abominations that they are doing."
verses.14: He brought me to the entrance of the gate of the house of the LORD, facing north, and behold, there were women sitting, weeping for Tammuz.
verses.15: He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man? You will yet see greater abominations than these."
verses.16: He brought me into the inner courtyard of the house of the LORD, to the entrance of the temple of the LORD, between the hall and the altar, where about twenty-five men stood with their backs to the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east, bowing down to the sun.
verses.17: He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man, is it too little for the house of Judah to commit these abominations? For they have filled the land with violence, and they turn back to provoke Me, and behold, they are sending forth their nose toward their anger."
verses.18: "And I will act with fury, my eye will not be merciful, nor will I show pity. Though they cry with a loud voice in my ears, I will not hear them."

notes:
Notes  
- v. 5: The location of the idol of jealousy (סֵמֶל הַקִּנְאָה) is specified as being at the north of the gate of the altar, which is a geographical detail unique to the vision.  
- v. 11: The name "Jaazaniah son of Shaphan" is a transliteration of the Hebrew יַעֲזַנְיָהוּ בֶן־שָׁפָן.  
- v. 14: "Tammuz" (תַּמּוּז) is a name of a Mesopotamian deity, associated with mourning rites.  
- v. 16: "Twenty-five men" (כָּעֶשְׂרִית וַחֲמִשָּׁה) is a literal translation of the Hebrew phrase "twenty-five men" and is retained as is.
